slides.headline: 2 killed. [[Grid hit again.]]
bullets: **Overnight (Oct 18):** Russian strikes killed 2 and injured 12, incl. 2 children, and hit substations in four regions, Zelenskyy says.
**Last 7 days:** almost 2,700 attack drones, 1,700 glide bombs, 66 missiles, Zelenskyy says. He says Russia hit energy sites 76 times since Trump's "energy ceasefire".
**St Petersburg:** governor says a Ukrainian drone attack killed 1, hit an oil terminal and depot. Leningrad governor: 145 drones downed. Moscow claims 1,015 downed overnight.
slides.sources: Sources: Al Jazeera citing AFP/Reuters (Oct 18). Casualty and drone figures are from officials of each side, not independently verified.

slides.headline: Today in [[4 numbers]]

stats.l: Russian attack drones in 7 days, Zelenskyy says (claim)
Ukrainian drones "neutralised" overnight, Russia's defence ministry claims
stats.s: Russian MoD via Al Jazeera, Oct 18

stats.l: Barrels through Hormuz on Oct 11, down from 20.8M on Oct 8
People displaced in Yemen since fighting escalated, per IOM

slides.sources: Sources: Al Jazeera, Kpler, IOM. Drone counts are party claims and unverified.

slides.headline: Tankers [[burn.]] Yemen war widens.
bullets: **Hormuz (Oct 18):** the IRGC says two tankers, ~2M barrels each, caught fire after hitting mines on a route Iran had not authorised. Ship names unconfirmed (Al Jazeera).
**Traffic:** Kpler: 2.9M barrels crossed on Oct 11 vs 20.8M on Oct 8. Trump says he expects a deal after the Nov 3 midterms.
**Yemen:** UKMTO says armed men on a skiff attacked an LNG tanker off Mukalla. A coalition helicopter crashed in Najran ("technical malfunction", 2 dead); the Houthis claim a shoot-down.
slides.sources: Sources: Al Jazeera, UKMTO, WHO, IOM, Kpler. IRGC, Houthi, coalition and Trump statements are claims.

slides.headline: Diplomats [[attacked.]] Gaza hit.
bullets: **Gaza (Oct 17):** Israeli drone strikes killed at least 6 Palestinians, per medical workers (Al Jazeera). Gaza Health Ministry: 1,511 killed since the Oct 2025 ceasefire; 74,469 since Oct 2023.
**West Bank:** settlers attacked European diplomats near Taybeh, incl. a French mayor, Belgium's FM says. Netanyahu's office calls reports "alleged". Palestine Red Crescent: 6 hurt in Ma'in.
slides.sources: Sources: Al Jazeera/AFP/AP (Oct 17), UNICEF. Health ministry and Israeli statements are claims.

slides.headline: Nyala: [[two accounts.]] Medicine gap.
bullets: **Nyala (Oct 16-17):** the RSF says an army drone hit a livestock market, killing **30** civilians. The army says it killed dozens of RSF fighters at positions. Emergency Lawyers say a market was hit by an army-linked drone. Unverified (AFP).
**Medicine:** only 8 of 30 shuttered Khartoum drug factories have resumed, per Sudan's medicines board. Pound: ~600/USD pre-war, ~9,300 on black market.
slides.sources: Sources: Al Jazeera/AFP (Oct 17-18). RSF and army statements are claims.

slides.headline: This [[week]]
bullets: **Ukraine:** Kyiv says it will resume refinery strikes; US sanctions waiver runs 60 days.
**Hormuz:** more mine or tanker incidents; Trump eyes a deal after Nov 3.
**Yemen/Saudi:** "Dawn of Yemen" offensive; Taiz hospitals running low on fuel.
**Israel/West Bank:** election Oct 27; reaction to the diplomat attack.

4 fronts. 24 hours. Here's what changed. ⬇️

🇺🇦 UKRAINE (Day 1,698) — Russian strikes killed 2 and hurt 12 overnight, hitting substations in four regions, Zelenskyy says. A Ukrainian drone attack on St Petersburg killed 1 and hit an oil terminal, the governor says; Moscow claims 1,015 drones downed (Al Jazeera/AFP/Reuters).

🇮🇷 IRAN WAR (Day 233) — The IRGC says two tankers caught fire after hitting mines in Hormuz; ships unconfirmed. Kpler: 2.9M barrels crossed Oct 11 vs 20.8M Oct 8. In Yemen, IOM says 233,000+ are displaced.

🇵🇸 GAZA / WEST BANK — Gaza Health Ministry: 1,511 killed since the ceasefire. Settlers attacked European diplomats near Taybeh (Al Jazeera/AFP).

🇸🇩 SUDAN — RSF says an army drone killed 30 in a Nyala market; the army says it hit RSF fighters. Unverified (AFP).

🎥 Slide 1: real footage (U.S. Marine Corps via DVIDS, Oct 12-13 training). Swipe for maps + numbers ➡️

Sources: Al Jazeera/AFP/Reuters, UKMTO, Kpler, IOM, WHO. Warring-party claims are unverified.

WORLD AT WAR: Sunday, Oct 18, 2026
4 fronts, 24 hours. Here's what changed.

🇺🇦 UKRAINE (Day 1,698)
• Russian strikes killed 2 and injured 12, incl. 2 children, and hit substations in Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Khmelnytskyi and Odesa regions, Zelenskyy says. Over 7 days Russia launched almost 2,700 drones, 1,700 bombs and 66 missiles, he says.
• A Ukrainian drone attack on St Petersburg killed 1 and injured 5, the governor says; oil sites burned. Leningrad's governor says 145 drones were downed; Moscow's ministry claims 1,015 overnight (Al Jazeera citing AFP/Reuters).
• Rubio says Ukraine has no Starshield access; Trump waived Russia energy sanctions for 60 days.

🇮🇷 IRAN WAR (Day 233)
• The IRGC says two tankers caught fire after hitting mines in Hormuz; ship names unconfirmed. Kpler: 2.9M barrels crossed Oct 11 vs 20.8M on Oct 8.
• Yemen: UKMTO says armed men on a skiff attacked an LNG tanker off Mukalla. IOM: 233,000+ displaced; WHO: Taiz city functionally isolated.

🇵🇸 GAZA / WEST BANK
• Israeli drone strikes killed at least 6 in Gaza, medics say. Health Ministry: 1,511 killed since the Oct 2025 ceasefire.
• Settlers attacked European diplomats near Taybeh, Belgium's FM says; Netanyahu's office calls reports "alleged".

🇸🇩 SUDAN
• The RSF says an army drone killed 30 civilians in a Nyala market; the army says it killed dozens of RSF fighters. Unverified (AFP via Al Jazeera).

Sources: Al Jazeera/AFP/Reuters, UKMTO, Kpler, IOM, WHO. Warring-party claims are unverified.
